name: Reference-guided Controllable Inpainting of NeRFs
definition: A 3D inpainting algorithm that uses a single inpainted reference view to guide the geometry and appearance of a NeRF, avoiding view inconsistencies and generating view-dependent effects.
summary: Reference-guided Controllable Inpainting of NeRFs is a 3D scene inpainting method that uses a single reference view to guide geometry and appearance, ensuring view consistency and generating view-dependent effects without requiring multi-view inputs.
